shortDescription: Foreign tourist arrivals to Indonesia grew 2.95% year-on-year to 1.52 million in July 2026, reversing a 2.15% decline in the previous month amid improving travel demand.

title: Indonesia Tourist Arrivals Rise 2.95% YoY
